item: Outlet page furniture counted apart in shared origins, the link preview and Explore Links
key_paths: src/analytics/link_furniture.py src/analytics/convergence.py src/api/link_analysis.py src/api/link_preview.py src/briefing/producers.py src/static/app-analysis.js src/static/app-home.js src/static/app-insights.js tests/test_link_furniture_counts.py
summary: The convergence shared-origin flag, the link preview's citing count and Explore > Links now ask the reader's one furniture measure (link_furniture.furniture_pairs): an article whose own outlet carries a link on at least half of its stored articles (20 or more) is not counted as citing it, and what is set aside is shown with its count. The measure is read per source from its own links and remembered per (database, source, article count); on a synthetic 500k-link corpus Explore Links over 1000 ids went from 22.8 s (per-URL shape) to 0.13 s. Six new strings in 12 locales.
